主要内容: The mobile gaming market is projected to grow by USD 66.43 billion at a CAGR of 12.26% from 2021 to 2026, with 47% of the growth coming from the Asia-Pacific region. The rise in mobile device adoption and internet penetration has driven game developers to create online mobile games. Free availability of games on app stores and the flexibility of mobile gaming are key growth drivers. Multiplayer games like MMOs and innovative titles such as Pokemon GO have further boosted market expansion. Smartphone manufacturers are also enhancing display technology to support mobile game development. However, the growth of gaming consoles presents a challenge. Key players include Electronic Arts Inc., Tencent Holdings Ltd. (700.HK), and Nintendo Co. Ltd. (7974.T), which are shaping the industry through competitive strategies and consumer engagement efforts.
